fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://www.ravensburger.us/en-US/products/games/games-for-kids/minecraft-heroes-of-the-village-20914. The official product article 20914 and Minecraft Heroes of the Village box match the English rule record. Reduced to 344 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently tamed an animal in Minecraft starts.
clarifications: If nobody qualifies, the youngest player begins. The starting player receives the white Illagers die during setup.
